doc: bench/obs.v1 ThermalObs golden vector (API-FR-132, API-AC-100): 8x6 radiometric_u16 frame. temp_ck_8x6.u16le.hex is the row-major u16 little-endian image (0.01 K per LSB), temp_ck_8x6.zst.hex the delivered bytes (zstd level 3, one frame, content size in the header) and obs_thermal_8x6.hex the wire.v1 OBS frame (u32le body_len, type 0x10, flags 0, version u16le 1, msgpack body {obs, inbox} with map keys in schema order).
